title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist brings a creature to life, then refuses to answer for what he has made. The original gothic novel about ambition and its consequences.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: A solicitor travels to Transylvania and uncovers a nightmare that follows him home. Told through letters, diaries and newspaper clippings.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy misjudge each other badly in this sharp, funny comedy of manners about love, money and first impressions.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Twelve short cases from the world's most famous consulting detective, narrated by his friend Dr. Watson.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit down a hole and lands in a world where logic has gone delightfully wrong.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphan becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall and finds a secret there. A story of independence, love and conscience.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: A foundling, a wild house on the Yorkshire moors, and a love that turns into revenge across two generations.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Captain Ahab's obsessive hunt for the white whale, narrated by the sailor Ishmael. An epic of the sea and of obsession.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: Young Jim Hawkins finds a pirate's map and sails in search of buried treasure, with Long John Silver aboard.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
description: A Kansas farm girl is swept away to a magical land and sets off along the yellow brick road to find the Wizard.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Nick Carraway watches his mysterious neighbor chase an old love through the glittering excess of the Jazz Age.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man stays unchanged while his portrait takes on the marks of his choices.

title: Leaves of Grass
author: Walt Whitman
description: Whitman's sprawling, joyful celebration of the self, the body, nature and democracy in free verse.

title: Walden
author: Henry David Thoreau
description: Two years in a cabin by a pond, and a lasting argument for simple living and paying attention.
